name: Chit Chat City
summary: Chit Chat City was a browser based free-to-play MMO and RPG Simulation. It's main features were socially interacting, making friends online, and engaging into activities. Chit Chat City allowed you to customize your online avatar by with accessories and gadgets. Players were able to interact with online players, make new friends, explore the game world, collect resources, build your own house and decorate it, and party with friends.
